speaker: mike
text: Welcome to Grant Park, Chicago! I'm Mike Brannigan, and this is the Kaiju Heavyweight Title!
caption: Welcome to Grant Park, Chicago! I'm Mike Brannigan, and this is the Kaiju Heavyweight Title!

speaker: vance
text: And I'm Sterling Vance, the smartest man within three hundred miles. You're welcome, Chicago.
caption: And I'm Sterling Vance, the smartest man within three hundred miles. You're welcome, Chicago.

speaker: mike
text: A hundred thousand people in Grant Park, and every one of them is standing too close.
caption: A hundred thousand people in Grant Park, and every one of them is standing too close.

speaker: vance
text: They paid for the splash zone, Brannigan. Let them enjoy it.
caption: They paid for the splash zone, Brannigan. Let them enjoy it.

speaker: mike
text: No referee. No count-out. No rules. Falls count anywhere in the city of Chicago!
caption: No referee. No count-out. No rules. Falls count anywhere in the city of Chicago!

speaker: vance
text: Finally, a fair fight. Rules only ever helped the crybabies.
caption: Finally, a fair fight. Rules only ever helped the crybabies.

speaker: mike
text: Folks, the mayor asked us to say this: the city is not responsible for your parked car.
caption: Folks, the mayor asked us to say this: the city is not responsible for your parked car.

speaker: vance
text: Or your office. Or your block.
caption: Or your office. Or your block.

speaker: mike
text: Best two out of three falls, and the whole city is the ring!
caption: Best two out of three falls, and the whole city is the ring!

speaker: vance
text: I hope you renters have insurance.
caption: I hope you renters have insurance.

speaker: mike
text: Gorrack, the pride of Lake Michigan, against the Iron Executioner, Meckra!
caption: Gorrak, the pride of Lake Michigan, against the Iron Executioner, Mechra!

speaker: vance
text: Flesh against the future, Brannigan. And the future has a plasma cannon.
caption: Flesh against the future, Brannigan. And the future has a plasma cannon.

speaker: mike
text: Gorrack grew up in that lake. Meckra was bolted together in a lab!
caption: Gorrak grew up in that lake. Mechra was bolted together in a lab!

speaker: vance
text: Exactly. One of them was built on purpose.
caption: Exactly. One of them was built on purpose.

speaker: mike
text: This city loves Gorrack, Vance.
caption: This city loves Gorrak, Vance.

speaker: vance
text: This city also loves ketchup-free hot dogs. Their judgment is suspect. Meckra in two straight.
caption: This city also loves ketchup-free hot dogs. Their judgment is suspect. Mechra in two straight.

speaker: mike
text: The hometown hero, Gorrack, against the Three-Headed Storm, Try-don!
caption: The hometown hero, Gorrak, against the Three-Headed Storm, Tridon!

speaker: vance
text: Three heads, Brannigan. That is three times the brains of that overgrown hedgehog.
caption: Three heads, Brannigan. That is three times the brains of that overgrown hedgehog.

speaker: mike
text: Try-don flew in this morning and has already insulted the pizza.
caption: Tridon flew in this morning and has already insulted the pizza.

speaker: vance
text: All three heads agreed it was a casserole. Royalty is never wrong.
caption: All three heads agreed it was a casserole. Royalty is never wrong.

speaker: mike
text: Gorrack fights for Chicago tonight!
caption: Gorrak fights for Chicago tonight!

speaker: vance
text: And Try-don fights for somebody that matters. Three somebodies, actually.
caption: And Tridon fights for somebody that matters. Three somebodies, actually.

speaker: mike
text: Meckra against Try-don. Folks, I do not know who to root for.
caption: Mechra against Tridon. Folks, I do not know who to root for.

speaker: vance
text: I do! Both of them! This is the greatest night of my life!
caption: I do! Both of them! This is the greatest night of my life!

speaker: mike
text: The Iron Executioner against the Three-Headed Storm. Somebody has to lose.
caption: The Iron Executioner against the Three-Headed Storm. Somebody has to lose.

speaker: vance
text: Not if they destroy the city first. Then everybody wins.
caption: Not if they destroy the city first. Then everybody wins.

speaker: mike
text: Two of the most despicable creatures in this sport, in one ring.
caption: Two of the most despicable creatures in this sport, in one ring.

speaker: vance
text: Two visionaries, Brannigan. Finally, a main event with some class.
caption: Two visionaries, Brannigan. Finally, a main event with some class.

speaker: mike
text: Two crowd favourites tonight. Chicago is going to cheer itself hoarse.
caption: Two crowd favourites tonight. Chicago is going to cheer itself hoarse.

speaker: vance
text: Disgusting. Not one decent villain in the building.
caption: Disgusting. Not one decent villain in the building.

speaker: mike
text: Here he comes, out of Lake Michigan! Listen to this city! Gorrack!
caption: Here he comes, out of Lake Michigan! Listen to this city! Gorrak!

speaker: vance
text: He tracks lake water everywhere he goes. Somebody get a mop.
caption: He tracks lake water everywhere he goes. Somebody get a mop.

speaker: mike
text: The Atomic Tyrant! Chicago's own! Gorrack is here!
caption: The Atomic Tyrant! Chicago's own! Gorrak is here!

speaker: vance
text: Tyrant. They cheer a thing called the tyrant. I rest my case about these people.
caption: Tyrant. They cheer a thing called the tyrant. I rest my case about these people.

speaker: mike
text: Look at the size of him! Look at those spines catch the sunset!
caption: Look at the size of him! Look at those spines catch the sunset!

speaker: vance
text: He looks like a cactus that lost a bar fight.
caption: He looks like a cactus that lost a bar fight.

speaker: mike
text: And here comes the Iron Executioner. Listen to these boos, Vance.
caption: And here comes the Iron Executioner. Listen to these boos, Vance.

speaker: vance
text: That's not booing. That's the sound of a city in awe. Meckra!
caption: That's not booing. That's the sound of a city in awe. Mechra!

speaker: vance
text: Feast your eyes, Brannigan. Forty thousand tons of pure engineering. Meckra!
caption: Feast your eyes, Brannigan. Forty thousand tons of pure engineering. Mechra!

speaker: mike
text: Forty thousand tons of bad attitude, you mean.
caption: Forty thousand tons of bad attitude, you mean.

speaker: mike
text: Meckra, stomping straight through what used to be the Loop.
caption: Mechra, stomping straight through what used to be the Loop.

speaker: vance
text: It took the shortest route. That's efficiency. You could learn something.
caption: It took the shortest route. That's efficiency. You could learn something.

speaker: vance
text: All rise! All rise for the Three-Headed Storm! Try-don!
caption: All rise! All rise for the Three-Headed Storm! Tridon!

speaker: mike
text: Nobody is rising, Vance.
caption: Nobody is rising, Vance.

speaker: mike
text: Here comes Try-don, and all three heads are arguing about who goes first.
caption: Here comes Tridon, and all three heads are arguing about who goes first.

speaker: vance
text: That's called a board meeting, Brannigan. Leadership.
caption: That's called a board meeting, Brannigan. Leadership.

speaker: mike
text: Try-don, soaking in the boos like it's a standing ovation.
caption: Tridon, soaking in the boos like it's a standing ovation.

speaker: vance
text: Three crowns, one body. You are looking at royalty, you peasant.
caption: Three crowns, one body. You are looking at royalty, you peasant.

speaker: mike
text: There's the bell! Here we go!
caption: There's the bell! Here we go!

speaker: mike
text: The bell rings in Grant Park, and we are underway!
caption: The bell rings in Grant Park, and we are underway!

speaker: mike
text: Chicago, are you ready? Here we go!
caption: Chicago, are you ready? Here we go!

speaker: vance
text: Somebody move the food trucks.
caption: Somebody move the food trucks.

speaker: mike
text: And there's the bell! Hold on to something, Chicago!
caption: And there's the bell! Hold on to something, Chicago!

speaker: vance
text: Ring the bell and get out of the way. Quickly.
caption: Ring the bell and get out of the way. Quickly.

speaker: mike
text: For once, Vance, good advice.
caption: For once, Vance, good advice.

speaker: mike
text: We are underway for the Kaiju Heavyweight Title!
caption: We are underway for the Kaiju Heavyweight Title!

speaker: mike
text: Second fall, here we go!
caption: Second fall, here we go!

speaker: mike
text: One fall in the books. The second is underway!
caption: One fall in the books. The second is underway!

speaker: vance
text: Pace yourself, Brannigan. There's a lot of city left.
caption: Pace yourself, Brannigan. There's a lot of city left.

speaker: mike
text: Back to it! Fall number two!
caption: Back to it! Fall number two!

speaker: mike
text: It all comes down to this! The deciding fall for the title!
caption: It all comes down to this! The deciding fall for the title!

speaker: vance
text: Winner takes the belt. Loser pays for the city.
caption: Winner takes the belt. Loser pays for the city.

speaker: mike
text: One fall apiece! This next one is for everything!
caption: One fall apiece! This next one is for everything!

speaker: mike
text: Third and deciding fall! Chicago is on its feet!
caption: Third and deciding fall! Chicago is on its feet!

speaker: vance
text: What's left of Chicago, anyway.
caption: What's left of Chicago, anyway.

speaker: mike
text: He got him! One fall to the good guys!
caption: He got him! One fall to the good guys!

speaker: vance
text: Fluke. Total fluke. I want that noted for the record.
caption: Fluke. Total fluke. I want that noted for the record.

speaker: mike
text: That's the fall! Listen to Grant Park!
caption: That's the fall! Listen to Grant Park!

speaker: vance
text: Listen to them. A hundred thousand people, all wrong.
caption: Listen to them. A hundred thousand people, all wrong.

speaker: mike
text: One, two, three! He takes the fall!
caption: One, two, three! He takes the fall!

speaker: vance
text: The count was fast. I don't care that there's no referee. It was fast.
caption: The count was fast. I don't care that there's no referee. It was fast.

speaker: vance
text: Ha ha! That's the fall! Write it down, Brannigan, in ink!
caption: Ha ha! That's the fall! Write it down, Brannigan, in ink!

speaker: mike
text: He stole one. But he got it.
caption: He stole one. But he got it.

speaker: mike
text: I hate to say it, folks. That's the fall.
caption: I hate to say it, folks. That's the fall.

speaker: vance
text: You love to say it. Say it again. Slower.
caption: You love to say it. Say it again. Slower.

speaker: vance
text: One fall for intelligence! One fall for class!
caption: One fall for intelligence! One fall for class!

speaker: mike
text: One fall for cheating, Vance.
caption: One fall for cheating, Vance.

speaker: mike
text: Gorrack takes the fall! Chicago's own takes the fall!
caption: Gorrak takes the fall! Chicago's own takes the fall!

speaker: vance
text: One. He needs two. Can he even count that high?
caption: One. He needs two. Can he even count that high?

speaker: vance
text: Calculated. Executed. Meckra takes the fall, exactly as I predicted.
caption: Calculated. Executed. Mechra takes the fall, exactly as I predicted.

speaker: mike
text: You predicted two minutes, Vance. It's been a lot longer than that.
caption: You predicted two minutes, Vance. It's been a lot longer than that.

speaker: vance
text: Three heads, one fall! Bow down, Chicago!
caption: Three heads, one fall! Bow down, Chicago!

speaker: mike
text: Try-don takes the fall, and now we have to listen to this.
caption: Tridon takes the fall, and now we have to listen to this.

speaker: mike
text: He's out! He is Out Cold!
caption: He's out! He is OUT COLD!

speaker: mike
text: Lights out! He is not getting up!
caption: Lights out! He is not getting up!

speaker: mike
text: Good night! Somebody check on him!
caption: Good night! Somebody check on him!

speaker: vance
text: Somebody check on the street he landed on.
caption: Somebody check on the street he landed on.

speaker: mike
text: Out cold in the middle of Chicago!
caption: Out cold in the middle of Chicago!

speaker: mike
text: No! No! Get up! Somebody help him!
caption: No! No! Get up! Somebody help him!

speaker: vance
text: Leave him. He looks comfortable.
caption: Leave him. He looks comfortable.

speaker: vance
text: Timber! Ha ha! Good night, hero!
caption: Timber! Ha ha! Good night, hero!

speaker: mike
text: Have some decency, Vance.
caption: Have some decency, Vance.

speaker: mike
text: Knocked out! Knocked all the way out!
caption: Knocked out! Knocked all the way out!

speaker: vance
text: He's resting! He's just resting his eyes! All of them!
caption: He's resting! He's just resting his eyes! All of them!

speaker: vance
text: Get up! Get Up! I have money on this!
caption: Get up! GET UP! I have money on this!

speaker: mike
text: He can't hear you, Vance. Nobody's home.
caption: He can't hear you, Vance. Nobody's home.

speaker: mike
text: He did it! He Did It! The good guys win the big one!
caption: He did it! HE DID IT! The good guys win the big one!

speaker: vance
text: This is the worst day of my life. And I was married four times.
caption: This is the worst day of my life. And I was married four times.

speaker: mike
text: Chicago has its champion! Listen to this city!
caption: Chicago has its champion! Listen to this city!

speaker: vance
text: I'm filing a protest. I'm filing six of them.
caption: I'm filing a protest. I'm filing six of them.

speaker: mike
text: What a fight! What a night! The title stays with the people!
caption: What a fight! What a night! The title stays with the people!

speaker: vance
text: The people. Ugh. I need a shower.
caption: The people. Ugh. I need a shower.

speaker: vance
text: Yes! Yes! Brains beats brawn! I have been telling you people for years!
caption: YES! YES! Brains beats brawn! I have been telling you people for years!

speaker: mike
text: A dark, dark night in Chicago, folks.
caption: A dark, dark night in Chicago, folks.

speaker: vance
text: Champion! Champion of the world! And he did it his way!
caption: Champion! Champion of the world! And he did it his way!

speaker: mike
text: His way was the low road, Vance. But the belt is his.
caption: His way was the low road, Vance. But the belt is his.

speaker: mike
text: I don't believe it. I do not believe it.
caption: I don't believe it. I do not believe it.

speaker: vance
text: Believe it, Brannigan! Somebody get me a cigar and a parade route!
caption: Believe it, Brannigan! Somebody get me a cigar and a parade route!

speaker: mike
text: Gorrack! Gorrack! The pride of Lake Michigan is the heavyweight champion!
caption: Gorrak! GORRAK! The pride of Lake Michigan is the heavyweight champion!

speaker: vance
text: Fine. Fine. Enjoy it, lizard. Rent's due on the first.
caption: Fine. FINE. Enjoy it, lizard. Rent's due on the first.

speaker: mike
text: Sweet home Chicago! Gorrack has done it!
caption: Sweet home Chicago! Gorrak has done it!

speaker: vance
text: I'm going to be sick. Right here on the desk.
caption: I'm going to be sick. Right here on the desk.

speaker: vance
text: The machine wins! The future is here, and it has a belt around its waist!
caption: The machine wins! The future is here, and it has a belt around its waist!

speaker: mike
text: Meckra is the champion. Heaven help this city.
caption: Mechra is the champion. Heaven help this city.

speaker: vance
text: Meckra! Flawless! Efficient! Somebody polish the champion!
caption: Mechra! Flawless! Efficient! Somebody polish the champion!

speaker: mike
text: Somebody hide the champion's off switch, before I find it.
caption: Somebody hide the champion's off switch, before I find it.

speaker: vance
text: Three heads! One crown! Long live the king! Kings! Long live all of them!
caption: Three heads! One crown! Long live the king! Kings! Long live all of them!

speaker: mike
text: Try-don is the champion, and we will never hear the end of it.
caption: Tridon is the champion, and we will never hear the end of it.

speaker: vance
text: Try-don! I knew it! All three of me knew it!
caption: Tridon! I knew it! All three of me knew it!

speaker: mike
text: There's one of you, Vance. One is plenty.
caption: There's one of you, Vance. One is plenty.

speaker: mike
text: Gorrack sends that bucket of bolts to the scrapyard! What a win!
caption: Gorrak sends that bucket of bolts to the scrapyard! What a win!

speaker: vance
text: It was a software update. Meckra was mid-update! It doesn't count!
caption: It was a software update. Mechra was mid-update! It doesn't count!

speaker: mike
text: Gorrack clips the wings of the Three-Headed Storm! He's the champion!
caption: Gorrak clips the wings of the Three-Headed Storm! He's the champion!

speaker: vance
text: Two of the heads weren't even trying. Recount!
caption: Two of the heads weren't even trying. Recount!

speaker: vance
text: Scrap metal? That scrap metal just flattened your hero, Brannigan!
caption: Scrap metal? That scrap metal just flattened your hero, Brannigan!

speaker: mike
text: Gorrack gave everything he had. Tonight, it wasn't enough.
caption: Gorrak gave everything he had. Tonight, it wasn't enough.

speaker: vance
text: Down goes the hedgehog! Royalty reigns in the Windy City!
caption: Down goes the hedgehog! Royalty reigns in the Windy City!

speaker: mike
text: Chicago is stunned. Gorrack is down, and Try-don has the title.
caption: Chicago is stunned. Gorrak is down, and Tridon has the title.

speaker: vance
text: You know, Brannigan, I used to manage champions.
caption: You know, Brannigan, I used to manage champions.

speaker: mike
text: You used to manage a car wash, Vance.
caption: You used to manage a car wash, Vance.

speaker: mike
text: The damage estimate is already in the billions, folks.
caption: The damage estimate is already in the billions, folks.

speaker: vance
text: Billions? In this neighbourhood? Please.
caption: Billions? In this neighbourhood? Please.

speaker: vance
text: I gave the pilot of that news helicopter twenty dollars to fly lower.
caption: I gave the pilot of that news helicopter twenty dollars to fly lower.

speaker: mike
text: Why would you do that?
caption: Why would you do that?

speaker: vance
text: Better seats.
caption: Better seats.

speaker: mike
text: A reminder: the Red Line is suspended until further notice.
caption: A reminder: the Red Line is suspended until further notice.

speaker: vance
text: Because it's wrapped around a kaiju. Read the room, Brannigan.
caption: Because it's wrapped around a kaiju. Read the room, Brannigan.

speaker: vance
text: Is my hair all right? We're on camera.
caption: Is my hair all right? We're on camera.

speaker: mike
text: There's a monster fight behind you, Vance. Nobody is looking at your hair.
caption: There's a monster fight behind you, Vance. Nobody is looking at your hair.

speaker: mike
text: I've called fights for thirty years. I have never worked a ring this size.
caption: I've called fights for thirty years. I have never worked a ring this size.

speaker: vance
text: Thirty years, and still no neck tie that matches.
caption: Thirty years, and still no neck tie that matches.

speaker: vance
text: I said it at the weigh-in and I'll say it again.
caption: I said it at the weigh-in and I'll say it again.

speaker: mike
text: The scale broke at the weigh-in.
caption: The scale broke at the weigh-in.

speaker: vance
text: Exactly my point.
caption: Exactly my point.

speaker: mike
text: They are selling deep dish in the stands tonight.
caption: They are selling deep dish in the stands tonight.

speaker: vance
text: That's not pizza. That's a casserole with a publicist.
caption: That's not pizza. That's a casserole with a publicist.

speaker: vance
text: Who's paying for all this, anyway?
caption: Who's paying for all this, anyway?

speaker: mike
text: The taxpayers, Vance.
caption: The taxpayers, Vance.

speaker: vance
text: Ha! Suckers.
caption: Ha! Suckers.

speaker: mike
text: If you're just joining us, you picked a good time.
caption: If you're just joining us, you picked a good time.

speaker: vance
text: If you just parked nearby, you picked a bad one.
caption: If you just parked nearby, you picked a bad one.

speaker: vance
text: I could do this, you know. Wrestle. I have the build.
caption: I could do this, you know. Wrestle. I have the build.

speaker: mike
text: You pulled a muscle opening your microphone, Vance.
caption: You pulled a muscle opening your microphone, Vance.

speaker: mike
text: The National Weather Service has classified this match as a weather event.
caption: The National Weather Service has classified this match as a weather event.

speaker: vance
text: That's the first accurate forecast they've had all year.
caption: That's the first accurate forecast they've had all year.

speaker: vance
text: Brannigan, when this is over, you're buying dinner.
caption: Brannigan, when this is over, you're buying dinner.

speaker: mike
text: With what restaurant, Vance? Look around.
caption: With what restaurant, Vance? Look around.

speaker: mike
text: Both of these monsters are breathing hard now.
caption: Both of these monsters are breathing hard now.

speaker: vance
text: I'd be breathing hard too if I had to listen to you for three falls.
caption: I'd be breathing hard too if I had to listen to you for three falls.

speaker: vance
text: I love this city. The wind. The lake. The breakable buildings.
caption: I love this city. The wind. The lake. The breakable buildings.

speaker: mike
text: That's the nicest thing you've said all night, and it's still terrible.
caption: That's the nicest thing you've said all night, and it's still terrible.

speaker: mike
text: We'd like to thank our broadcast crew, who are very brave, and very far away.
caption: We'd like to thank our broadcast crew, who are very brave, and very far away.

speaker: vance
text: Cowards. I'm right here. Behind you.
caption: Cowards. I'm right here. Behind you.

speaker: vance
text: You know what your hero's problem is, Brannigan? No vision.
caption: You know what your hero's problem is, Brannigan? No vision.

speaker: mike
text: He's got heart, Vance.
caption: He's got heart, Vance.

speaker: vance
text: Heart doesn't have a cannon.
caption: Heart doesn't have a cannon.

speaker: mike
text: The people are behind the good guy tonight!
caption: The people are behind the good guy tonight!

speaker: vance
text: The people are behind a fence, and it's not going to help them.
caption: The people are behind a fence, and it's not going to help them.

speaker: vance
text: I'm not saying he cheats. I'm saying he wins creatively.
caption: I'm not saying he cheats. I'm saying he wins creatively.

speaker: mike
text: That is exactly what cheating is, Vance.
caption: That is exactly what cheating is, Vance.

speaker: mike
text: You could try being fair for one night.
caption: You could try being fair for one night.

speaker: vance
text: I'm always fair. I'm fair to the side that's right.
caption: I'm always fair. I'm fair to the side that's right.

speaker: vance
text: Heroes. Always with the heart, and the courage, and the losing.
caption: Heroes. Always with the heart, and the courage, and the losing.

speaker: mike
text: He's not losing, Vance.
caption: He's not losing, Vance.

speaker: vance
text: Give it time.
caption: Give it time.

speaker: vance
text: I can't lose tonight, Brannigan. Whoever wins, I was right.
caption: I can't lose tonight, Brannigan. Whoever wins, I was right.

speaker: mike
text: And whoever wins, Chicago was wrong to sell tickets.
caption: And whoever wins, Chicago was wrong to sell tickets.

speaker: mike
text: No good guys in this one, folks. Just pick the one you dislike less.
caption: No good guys in this one, folks. Just pick the one you dislike less.

speaker: vance
text: I'll take both. In fact, I'll take them to dinner.
caption: I'll take both. In fact, I'll take them to dinner.

speaker: vance
text: Look at that. Professionals, going about their business.
caption: Look at that. Professionals, going about their business.

speaker: mike
text: Their business is wrecking my city!
caption: Their business is wrecking my city!

speaker: vance
text: And business is good.
caption: And business is good.

speaker: vance
text: Meckra runs on a fusion core. Your boy runs on lake water and applause.
caption: Mechra runs on a fusion core. Your boy runs on lake water and applause.

speaker: mike
text: And he's still standing, isn't he?
caption: And he's still standing, isn't he?

speaker: mike
text: Meckra hasn't blinked once in this fight.
caption: Mechra hasn't blinked once in this fight.

speaker: vance
text: It doesn't have eyelids. It has a visor. That's called an upgrade.
caption: It doesn't have eyelids. It has a visor. That's called an upgrade.

speaker: vance
text: Meckra calculated four hundred ways to win this match.
caption: Mechra calculated four hundred ways to win this match.

speaker: mike
text: Has it calculated what happens when Gorrack gets angry?
caption: Has it calculated what happens when Gorrak gets angry?

speaker: vance
text: That's a rounding error.
caption: That's a rounding error.

speaker: vance
text: Try-don has three heads. That's a head for offence, a head for defence, and a head for looking good.
caption: Tridon has three heads. That's a head for offence, a head for defence, and a head for looking good.

speaker: mike
text: And not one of them saw that last shot coming.
caption: And not one of them saw that last shot coming.

speaker: mike
text: Gorrack is fighting three heads at once, and he's holding his own!
caption: Gorrak is fighting three heads at once, and he's holding his own!

speaker: vance
text: That's because the left one is lazy. Always has been.
caption: That's because the left one is lazy. Always has been.

speaker: vance
text: You ever try to argue with royalty, Brannigan?
caption: You ever try to argue with royalty, Brannigan?

speaker: mike
text: I'm doing it right now, apparently.

text: Cindervault is glowing brighter and brighter! He's about to blow!
caption: Cindervault is glowing brighter and brighter! He's about to blow!

caption: Cindervault is erupting with rage!

text: Look at the cracks open up! It's like a sunrise inside that thing!
caption: Look at the cracks open up! It's like a sunrise inside that thing!

caption: The most beautiful sunrise you'll ever see. The last one, too.

caption: He hit him with everything, and Cindervault didn't even move!

caption: Ha! Did you think a punch was going to hurt solid rock?

caption: Cindervault shrugged that off like it was a raindrop.

caption: Down into the volcano he goes! No return ticket!

caption: CALDERA COLLAPSE! He caved in the whole park!

caption: Cindervault tears that building right out of the ground!

caption: Cindervault drops on him like a landslide! Kick out!

caption: Cindervault smashes right through the guard! You can't block a rockslide!

caption: The lights have gone out in Grant Park! All but one! Here comes Brineveil!

caption: All the way up from the bottom of the ocean, just to be booed by Chicago! What an honour!

caption: Brineveil slides up out of the harbour, and there's a glow on the water like a ghost ship!

caption: Brineveil takes the fall! He lured him in, and he reeled him in!

caption: Patience, Brannigan! The deep sea teaches patience!

caption: Ha! He never saw it coming! Nobody ever sees it coming at the bottom of the ocean!

speaker: mike
text: Brine-veil wins it, and Chicago smells like low tide.

caption: Every hero who looked at that light is going home in a bucket!

caption: Brineveil darts in and bites him!

speaker: mike

speaker: vance
